text: This report recommends approval of two grants with a combined value of $155,000.

The Board of Directors of the Toronto Atmospheric Fund: 1. Approved the following grants to be funded from the endowments indicated: a. $35,000 over 10 months (from the Canada, Toronto and Ontario endowments) to Toronto Society of Architects to create a Design Guide for low-carbon mid-rise housing building typologies. b. $120,000 over 18 months (from the Toronto and Canada endowments only) to Clean Energy Canada to ensure home charging access for condominium and apartment dwellers.
